details: Network-level crashes are a serious and widespread issue in VRChat that current safety settings cannot protect against, as they bypass client-side protections entirely. While Easy Anti-Cheat was introduced to prevent modified clients, it is being circumvented, meaning crashers remain a significant problem. Making matters worse, VRChat's current output logs do not identify who is responsible for causing these crashes — only that a crash occurred. This makes it nearly impossible for players to file effective moderation reports, and for the Trust & Safety team to take targeted action. We are asking VRChat to improve their logging and diagnostic tools to attribute network-level crash events to specific user IDs, giving both players and moderators the ability to identify and report attackers accurately. Without this, the reporting system has a fundamental gap that bad actors are actively exploiting. Please prioritize fixing the underlying network exploits and improving crash attribution in logs — the current situation is making VRChat unsafe for many users.
title: Network-level crashes
